title: Dashboard
caption: Calendar of what goes live when, stats at a glance, notes and to-dos — everything an editor needs on one screen.

hotspots.label: This month
hotspots.text: Scheduled and published entries on a calendar; click a day.

hotspots.label: Stats
hotspots.text: Entries, drafts and media — live from the pod.

hotspots.label: Station dock
hotspots.text: Collections, tools and the command palette in one floating dock.

title: Security check
caption: The security check tells admins what to fix before it bites: plaintext credentials, an open API, a pod tracked by git — each with the fix. Same as orbiter doctor.

hotspots.label: Security check
hotspots.text: Findings with the fix next to each one — encrypt credentials, require a token…

title: Editor
caption: The body stays the main content — block editor, AI assistant and suggestions. Custom fields wait in a collapsible card above it.

hotspots.label: Details card
hotspots.text: Collapsed, it takes one line. Open it when you need the fields.

hotspots.label: Block editor
hotspots.text: Write in blocks; insert media, tables and callouts.

hotspots.label: AI & suggestions
hotspots.text: Local (Ollama) or cloud models; translate missing languages as drafts.

title: Custom fields
caption: Open the Details card: fields grouped as in your schema, two per row, long inputs at full width. It remembers how you left it.

hotspots.label: Collapsible card
hotspots.text: Click to collapse; the choice is remembered per collection.

hotspots.label: Grouped fields
hotspots.text: Groups come from your schema; the first one opens by default.

hotspots.label: Room for long fields
hotspots.text: Text areas, tables, relations and media take the full row.

title: Review workflow
caption: Editors submit, reviewers approve. In-review, scheduled and draft entries are one filter away.

hotspots.label: Status filters
hotspots.text: Published, drafts, in review, scheduled, trash.

hotspots.label: In review
hotspots.text: Waiting for a reviewer — nothing goes live by accident.

hotspots.label: Scheduled
hotspots.text: Publishes itself at the time you set.

title: Media
caption: Usage badges, unused and broken-reference filters, and focal points so crops keep the subject in frame.

hotspots.label: Clean-up filters
hotspots.text: Find unused files and entries pointing at deleted media.

hotspots.label: Where is it used?
hotspots.text: Every file shows how many entries use it.

hotspots.label: Focal point
hotspots.text: Click the important part; ?ar=16:9 crops respect it.

title: Account & sessions
caption: Two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app, recovery codes, and every signed-in device with one-click sign-out.

hotspots.label: Two-factor
hotspots.text: TOTP with one-time recovery codes; codes can’t be replayed.

hotspots.label: Active sessions
hotspots.text: Browser, IP and time — sign out any device.

title: Keys & webhooks
caption: API keys with scopes, expiry and rate limits. Signed webhooks with retries and a delivery log.

hotspots.label: API keys
hotspots.text: Read-only, or draft-only for agents — limited to collections, with an expiry date.

hotspots.label: Signed webhooks
hotspots.text: HMAC-signed, retried, logged.
